# tcgp-deck-qr

Vendored browser bundle from [KevinGutowski/tcgp-deck-qr](https://github.com/KevinGutowski/tcgp-deck-qr).

- Commit: `102d75e45ad244099d22ea5beba7bba57ad51be2`
- Upstream file: `dist/tcgp-deck-qr.js` (saved here as `.mjs`)
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE`.
- Includes jsQR and qrcode-generator; their license notices are distributed alongside the bundle.

Loaded on demand by `deck-qr.mjs`. No remote card database is fetched; card identities come from the local RaenonX catalog and existing image URLs.
